answer: Random beacon audits with compute heartbeats block bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities; each picked agent must return a heartbeat in ten minutes, proving live work. A climber at the summit must file from the jetty log, and a watcher on the ledge checks the timestamp matches the route. Faking 1,000 identities costs 50 credits each, 50,000 total, for smaller rewards. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full, undiluted share.
